notes.title: The Willow Man - Now Available on Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=4jo-Zsz5Raw;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pixel-game-maker-series-the-willow-man-switch/]Nintendo E Shop Link Here[/url]

I am pleased to announce that [b]"The Willow Man"[/b] is now been released for [b]"Nintendo Switch"[/b]. Its was an interesting journey in a sense that I didn't think I was worthy of releasing on an actually platform. Yet here we are its real, its playable in 2 Languages, and is now able to travel with you anywhere your Nintendo Switch goes. Its amazing really I couldn't be happier to share "The Willow Man" with more people.


Remember your dreams are not insignificant. Dreams are who we are deep down and I hope everyone has a chance to share them with someone soon.


[b]About the Game:[/b]

"The Willow Man" is a survival Horror Game 

---Key Features

Frantic Chases

Sanity Meter

Boss Fights

Multiple Endings

Survive, Fight, or Hide to survive the night

Thank For Reading and I hope you all have a wonderful day.

notes.title: Update For Willow Man - Small Update
notes.notes: Hey everyone just letting you know about a new patch for "The Willow Man". Fixed the UI scaling issues of well the player controls images.  So now instead of being greeted with a picture of a note pad with instructions on how to control player. You are greeted with a nice image all the player controls with all button prompts in place for both keyboard and game pad. Anyway thanks to everyone who took the time to even try the game. It means the world to me. Remember never stop dreaming everyone.
